title: Anthropic launches $85K fellowship to boost Claude use in #anthropic #claudefellowship #aiforgood
description: Anthropic launched a fellowship paying a thousand people $85,000 a year to learn and use Claude, its AI assistant, over 12 months in nonprofit roles. The program supports over 400 nonprofits across areas like food banks, veteran support, marine conservation, and education, providing fellows with training, a large Claude token budget, and placements to improve organizational impact. Backed by $150 million, this initiative targets individuals with under two years of work experience and no specific degree requirements, aiming to expand AI skills among emerging professionals while driving social good. The first cohort starts in October 2026, reflecting a strategic investment in AI-powered nonprofit innovation and workforce development. This fellowship illustrates a market shift where AI tools are integrated into social sectors to amplify impact and create new career pathways. It highlights Anthropic’s role in democratizing AI access and strengthening real-world applications that address community needs. #Anthropic #ClaudeAI #AIfellowship #NonprofitAI #SocialImpact #ArtificialIntelligence #AIforGood #TechForNonprofits #AIWorkforce #Claude #AIInnovation #Fellowship2026 #AItrained #MachineLearning #TechForChange
